overview.sample.description: Neutral pill in the greeting band while the Overview shows built-in sample numbers, not the shop's own

overview.greet.morning.description: Greeting before noon. {name} is the owner's first name.

overview.greet.afternoon.description: Greeting from noon to 5 pm. {name} is the owner's first name.

overview.greet.evening.description: Greeting from 5 pm. {name} is the owner's first name.

overview.greet.sub.defaultMessage: {date} · {store} · {waiting, plural, =0 {no orders waiting} one {# order waiting} other {# orders waiting}}
overview.greet.sub.description: Line under the greeting. {date} is like 'Thursday, 22 October'; {store} is the shop name.

overview.period.label.description: Accessible name of the Today / 7 days / 30 days switch

overview.compare.today.description: What today's numbers are compared with. {weekday} is like 'Thursday'.

overview.compare.7d.description: What the 7-day numbers are compared with

overview.compare.30d.description: What the 30-day numbers are compared with

overview.compareShort.today.description: KPI footer comparison. {weekday} is like 'Thursday' on the lead cell and 'Thu' on the others.

overview.synced.description: Sync state in the top bar. {time} is like '6:40 pm'.

overview.newSale.description: Primary button in the top bar; opens the counter (Sell)

overview.kpi.label.description: Accessible name of the KPI strip

overview.kpi.sales.today.description: Lead KPI name for the Today period

overview.kpi.sales.period.description: Lead KPI name for the 7 and 30 day periods

overview.kpi.sales.note.defaultMessage: {bills, plural, one {# bill} other {# bills}} · {online, plural, one {# online order} other {# online orders}}

overview.kpi.orders.note.defaultMessage: {waiting, plural, =0 {None waiting to accept} other {# waiting to accept}}

overview.kpi.avgBill.note.description: Line under the average bill value

overview.kpi.low.description: KPI name: items at or under their low-stock level

overview.kpi.low.note.defaultMessage: {soon, plural, =0 {None sell out by tomorrow} other {# sell out by tomorrow}}
overview.kpi.low.note.description: Line under the low items count

overview.kpi.low.link.description: KPI footer link to the low-stock list

overview.delta.up.description: Screen-reader text for a rising KPI. {value} is like '12%' or '5'.

overview.delta.down.description: Screen-reader text for a falling KPI

overview.delta.flat.description: Screen-reader text for an unchanged KPI

overview.orders.waiting.description: Pill in the new orders card head

overview.orders.head.description: Order card heading: order code and customer name

overview.orders.timeLeft.description: Screen-reader text for the countdown. {time} is like '3:42'.

overview.orders.expired.description: Screen-reader text when the countdown reached zero

overview.orders.accept.description: Accept button on a new order

overview.orders.reject.description: Reject button on a new order

overview.orders.acceptA11y.description: Accessible name of the Accept button

overview.orders.rejectA11y.description: Accessible name of the Reject button

overview.orders.sampleToast.description: Toast after Accept or Reject on a sample order. Nothing is sent or saved.

overview.orders.open.description: Toast action that opens the Orders section

overview.chart.prev.description: Chart legend: the dotted line for the same weekday last week

overview.chart.a11y.defaultMessage: Sales by hour today against last {weekday}. {hour}, so far: {now}; last {weekday}: {prev}.

overview.chart.hourAm.description: Short x-axis hour label before noon, like '8a'

overview.chart.hourPm.description: Short x-axis hour label from noon, like '6p'

overview.chart.axisK.description: Y-axis label in thousands of rupees, like '₹2k'

overview.chart.tipHour.description: Tooltip heading for the current hour, like '6 pm, so far'

overview.chart.tipPrev.description: Tooltip line with last week's amount for the same hour

overview.insights.desc.defaultMessage: What sells, what sits, what is about to go to waste, and what people nearby want

overview.insights.notUseful.description: Quiet button on an insight row; hides that row's item

overview.insights.hiddenToast.defaultMessage: Hidden for this visit. Sample data: nothing is saved.
overview.insights.hiddenToast.description: Toast after Not useful on a sample insight

overview.insights.all.description: Card footer link to the Insights tab of Analytics

overview.insights.foot.defaultMessage: From your sales, stock and searches near your shop

overview.insights.selling_fast.sentence.defaultMessage: {item} sold {sold} this week. At this pace you run out on {day}.
overview.insights.selling_fast.sentence.description: Insight sentence. {day} is a weekday like 'Saturday'.

overview.insights.selling_fast.action.description: Insight action; opens the restock form prefilled

overview.insights.sitting_on_shelf.sente.defaultMessage: {item}: {stock} in stock, no sale in {days} days.

overview.insights.sitting_on_shelf.actio.description: Insight action; opens the offer form prefilled

overview.insights.going_to_waste.sentenc.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# item expires} other {# items expire}} within {days} days: {items}.
overview.insights.going_to_waste.sentenc.description: Insight sentence. {items} is a comma-separated list of item names.

overview.insights.going_to_waste.action.description: Insight action; opens the flash offer form prefilled

overview.insights.wanted_nearby.sentence.defaultMessage: {item}: {searches} searches within {distance} this week. No shop nearby has it.
overview.insights.wanted_nearby.sentence.description: Insight sentence when no shop nearby lists the product (D-99)

overview.insights.wanted_nearby.action.description: Insight action; opens add item prefilled

overview.insights.bought_together.senten.defaultMessage: {a} and {b} are in {pct}% of bills together.

overview.insights.bought_together.action.description: Insight action; opens the offer form with the two items

overview.top.titlePeriod.description: Card title for the 7 and 30 day periods

overview.top.spark.description: Accessible name of the sparkline. {values} is a comma-separated list of counts.

overview.top.low.description: Screen-reader text for a low stock count

overview.top.updated.description: Column header: source and time of the last stock change

overview.top.source.pos.description: Last stock change came from the counter

overview.top.source.online.description: Last stock change came from an online order

overview.top.source.voice.description: Last stock change came from a voice entry

overview.loading.description: Accessible text while the Overview loads

overview.hour.am.description: An hour of the day before noon, like '8 am'

overview.hour.pm.description: An hour of the day from noon, like '6 pm'

overview.retry.description: Button on the error banner; loads the overview again
